snippet.title: Mortal Kombat 1: Definitive Edition - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
An Era built for peace and tranquility is destined to fester with Khaos and deception.

Experience the ultimate version of Liu Kang’s New Era with the Mortal Kombat 1: Definitive Edition, available now.

New Movie Skins also available today.

https://www.mortalkombat.com/purchase

It's In Our Blood. Discover a reborn Mortal Kombat Universe created by Fire God Liu Kang. Mortal Kombat 1 ushers in a New Era of the iconic franchise with a new fighting system, game modes, and Fatalities!
